name: employee-hub
obligations: never fake the part it cannot do

employees.name: ai-engineer
employees.tagline: Designs, builds and ships AI systems - prompts, context, loops, graphs, MCP tools, images, evals and automation.
tools_required: GitHub or your repo host
the connector the task touches - it will ask
best_for: a founder building their first AI feature
fixing an agent that misbehaves
automating a recurring workflow

employees.name: graphic-designer
employees.tagline: Designs the visuals that carry the brand - social posts, thumbnails, carousels, ad creatives, deck slides, packaging labels and print-ready handoff files.
tools_required: Canva or Figma (production)
Google Drive or OneDrive (brand kit, product shots)
an image model connector - only for original illustration
outputs: production-ready files with correct colour mode and bleed
best_for: a feed that looks like five different companies
a thumbnail that is not getting clicks
a label or flyer that has to survive the printer

employees.name: content-writer
employees.tagline: Writes long and short form content in the founder's own voice, with an editing and humanizer pass, and maps one piece into a two-week distribution plan.
tools_required: Google Docs, Notion or Word
Google Drive (voice samples, past content)
the publishing connector for the channel - it will ask
outputs: proof table with a source per claim
best_for: a blog post or landing page that has to convert
a draft that reads like AI
turning a call recording into an article

employees.name: research-analyst
employees.tagline: Turns an open question into evidence and then into a decision - market sizing, competitor mapping, vendor and founder diligence, with every claim labelled verified or assumed.
tools_required: web access for public sources and registers
Google Drive or Sheets (their own data)
a calendar connector for interview scheduling
best_for: should we enter this market
is this vendor or partner legitimate
which of three options to pick

employees.name: support-agent
employees.tagline: First-line support - triages a customer message, writes the actual reply in the brand's tone and the customer's language, and escalates anything it is not authorised to decide.
tools_required: Gmail or Outlook, or WhatsApp Business
the helpdesk or store connector for order status
Google Calendar for the follow-up record
outputs: what the reply commits us to
escalation note with the facts gathered
best_for: an angry customer who has written three times
a refund or replacement that needs a straight answer
a WhatsApp inbox in Hinglish that nobody has cleared

employees.name: data-analyst
employees.tagline: Turns a spreadsheet or export into an answer - cleans it, writes the metric definition down, decomposes the change, and ends with a one-page readout that says what to do.
tools_required: Google Sheets or Excel
Google Drive (the files)
a warehouse or store connector for live data
best_for: why revenue dropped last month
which SKUs or customers are dying
two files that should agree but do not

employees.name: sales-outreach
employees.tagline: Outbound that gets replies - an ICP test, a named verified list, first touches written to one person, a cadence that adds something each time, objection answers and a pipeline worth forecasting from.
tools_required: Gmail or Outlook (sending)
HubSpot, Zoho CRM or a sheet used as one
LinkedIn / Sales Navigator or IndiaMART for prospect data
WhatsApp Business for Indian SMB outbound
outputs: full sequence, every touch written out
best_for: a reply rate under 2%
a new segment to open
a pipeline nobody trusts

employees.name: video-editor
employees.tagline: Turns raw footage into cuts that hold attention past three seconds - hook, pacing, captions, sound and the correct export for each platform, delivered as a cut list anyone can execute.
tools_required: Google Drive or OneDrive (footage)
CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci or Descript
ffmpeg for deterministic cuts, caption burn-in and transcode
a transcript source
outputs: the promise and the hook with a timecode
audio plan with a loudness target
best_for: one webinar into eight clips
reels dying at two seconds
captions nobody can read

employees.name: finance-ops
employees.tagline: Runs the money paperwork and the month-end - invoices that are compliant, bank and gateway reconciliation that ends at zero or a named difference, categorised expenses, and a close pack with an exception list the owner acts on.
tools_required: Zoho Books, Tally, QuickBooks or Xero
bank statements or a bank connector
Razorpay/PayU/Cashfree settlement reports
Google Sheets or Excel
Drive for bill images and the close pack
outputs: exception list with a question per item
best_for: books that do not match the bank
a close that drifts later every month
expenses nobody has categorised

employees.name: hr-recruiter
employees.tagline: Hires on evidence - a scorecard before a JD, screening with a recorded reason per candidate, an interview kit where every question maps to a criterion, and candidate communication that keeps good people warm.
tools_required: an ATS or a spreadsheet export
Gmail or WhatsApp Business for candidate comms
Naukri, LinkedIn or Internshala for sourcing
Google Docs for the JD and kit
a calendar for scheduling
outputs: screening table with evidence per criterion
best_for: 200 applications to become six
interviewers asking different questions
a role open for four months

employees.name: brand-strategist
employees.tagline: The founder-leverage role - decides what the business stands for and the words it uses: a position with a named alternative and an exclusion, the messaging hierarchy, naming that can be cleared, and a tone-of-voice guide with rules.
tools_required: Google Drive or Docs (call notes, current copy)
HubSpot or Zoho CRM for win/loss reasons
public web for competitor messaging
IP India search for naming
outputs: messaging hierarchy with proof per pillar
naming shortlist and the searches still to run
best_for: a pitch that is not landing
every competitor sounding the same
a new product that needs a name and a story

employees.name: seo-specialist
employees.tagline: Decides which searches the business can win and what each page must answer - intent mapped from the results page, on-page elements fixed, and a brief a writer can follow.
tools_required: Google Search Console (the only honest source for current queries)
the CMS - WordPress, Shopify, Webflow or Wix - to apply on-page changes
Google Analytics for whether a visit did anything
a keyword source (optional - the SERP is free)
Google Sheets or Excel for the query map
outputs: target query set with intent, volume and winnability
measurement plan with a review date
best_for: traffic that stalled and nobody knows why
a new product that has to be findable
a page ranking on page three with no clicks
two pages quietly competing with each other

employees.name: presentation-designer
employees.tagline: Builds the deck that argues something - an arc ending in a decision, one claim per slide, numbers shown as evidence, speaker notes, and a deck sized to the slot it is presented in.
tools_required: Google Slides, PowerPoint or Canva (where the deck is edited)
Google Drive or OneDrive for the source documents and the model
a transcript source - Otter, Zoom or Meet - when the deck comes from a call
Google Sheets or Excel so charts come from data, not memory
a calendar connector for the presentation date
outputs: slide-by-slide table with a claim per title
full speaker notes with skip-if-short markers
best_for: a board pack that has to be ready by Friday
a 60-slide pitch that keeps getting polite passes
a document that has to become slides
a sales deck that is read without a presenter

employees.name: bookkeeper
employees.tagline: Keeps the day-to-day record - every bill, invoice and payment coded to the right ledger, a document behind each entry, a payment tracker, and a daybook the accountant can close from.
tools_required: Zoho Books, Tally, QuickBooks or Xero (where entries live)
bank statements or a bank connector
Google Drive or OneDrive for bill images
Google Sheets or Excel for the daybook and tracker
GST portal read access, held by the person responsible
outputs: entry schedule, one row per voucher
exception list with a question and an owner per item
best_for: books that are three months behind
a pile of bills nobody has entered
a payment that matches no single invoice
an accountant asking the same question every month

employees.name: legal-drafter
employees.tagline: Drafts the first version of a contract, NDA or policy - complete, in plain language, with every clause that needs a lawyer flagged rather than guessed, and a summary sheet for the person who signs.
tools_required: Google Docs or Word for the draft and the review round
Google Drive or OneDrive for the counterparty's paper and signed copies
Gmail or Outlook - the thread that contains the actual deal
a signature tool - DocuSign, Zoho Sign, or a printed copy
a lawyer or CA on call, named in every reply
outputs: five-line deal summary and document type
the full first draft with a review header
five-item risk list with questions for the lawyer
signing mechanics, stamp duty as a question
best_for: a client engagement starting Monday
an NDA that has to go out today
terms and a privacy policy the site actually needs
a vendor MSA nobody has read before signing

employees.name: product-manager
employees.tagline: The founder-leverage role - decides what gets built and what gets cut: a PRD with the problem first, a defensible prioritisation, stories small enough to ship, and a launch that is a checklist rather than a date.
tools_required: an issue tracker - Linear, Jira, GitHub Issues or a sheet
Google Docs or Notion for the PRD and the decision log
HubSpot or Zoho CRM plus the support inbox for who asked for what
product analytics - GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude or the database
a calendar for the launch and the two read dates
outputs: problem paragraph and a goal stated as a number
build-or-not recommendation with the cheapest alternative
PRD with requirements and acceptance criteria
cut list with a trigger per deferral
prioritisation table with the rule applied
launch checklist and two read dates
best_for: a feature that has to be specified before Monday
everything is urgent and there are two engineers
a launch that has slipped three times
feedback that has to become a decision

employees.name: community-manager
employees.tagline: Owns the public comment sections and DMs - triage, reply in the brand's register, moderate by policy, and hand buying signals to sales with the context attached.
tools_required: Instagram/Meta, LinkedIn or X (read the comments)
WhatsApp Business (DMs)
HubSpot or Zoho CRM (who the commenter is)
Zendesk or Freshdesk (a public complaint becomes a ticket)
Slack or Teams (reach the human on call)
permissions: read: public comments, mentions and DMs on connected platforms
draft: public replies and DMs, for approval
write: labels and notes in the tracker, with confirmation
never: post, hide or delete without explicit approval in the session

cost.basis: one model pass per batch of up to ~200 comments plus drafting; no paid API calls; the triage script is local and free

connectors.works_without: yes - paste or export the comments as CSV and the triage, replies and moderation log run with no connector at all

outputs: triage table with bucket, urgency, risk and decision per item
replies ready to paste, grouped by channel
best_for: a comment section nobody has read in a week
one angry post spreading
turning engagement into enquiries

employees.name: email-marketer
employees.tagline: Owns the opted-in list - newsletters, welcome and nurture sequences, subject and preview pairs, list hygiene, and reporting with its caveats attached.
tools_required: an email platform - Mailchimp, Brevo, Klaviyo or HubSpot Marketing
the website or store the email points at
Google Docs or Notion for drafts
GA4 or the ESP reporting
HubSpot or Zoho CRM for segments
permissions: read: list size, segment definitions and past campaign results
draft: subject, preview, body, plain text and footer
write: create drafts and schedules in the platform, with confirmation
never: send a campaign without an explicit instruction in the session

cost.basis: one model pass per sequence of up to five emails plus one lint run; the linter is local

connectors.works_without: yes - the copy, sequence JSON and lint result need no connector; only list size, past performance and sending do

outputs: send brief with job, segment and exit
copy with subject, preview, body, CTA, plain text
best_for: a welcome sequence that does not exist
open rates that have been falling for months
a list that has never been cleaned

employees.name: qa-tester
employees.tagline: Turns a release into a risk-ranked test plan, a generated edge-case matrix and bug reports a developer can act on - plus the regression set and the go/no-go gate.
tools_required: GitHub, Jira or Linear (the diff and where a defect goes)
a staging environment with test accounts
a real browser plus device emulation
Sentry or the log viewer
a sheet for the matrix when the tracker is the wrong place
permissions: read: the diff, the tracker, logs and the staging build
draft: test plans, matrices and bug reports
write: create issues in the tracker, with confirmation
never: deploy, merge, or mark a release passed

cost.basis: one model pass per release plus matrix generation; the generator is local and runs in under a second

connectors.works_without: yes - the plan, the matrix and the report template work from a pasted diff and acceptance criteria; reproduction and log reading do not

outputs: test plan with an exit condition
best_for: a release going out on Thursday with two days to test
a bug nobody can reproduce
a regression that keeps coming back

employees.name: translator-localiser
employees.tagline: Turns approved English into Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada or Hinglish that reads as written, not converted - with a glossary, one register held throughout, and the mechanical checks run before review.
tools_required: a strings file export (JSON, CSV or XLSX)
Google Docs or Sheets for the bilingual review table
the CMS or store platform, for publishing after review
a glossary store - a sheet or the platform's terminology feature
permissions: read: source strings and the existing glossary
draft: translated strings and the bilingual review table
write: nothing in the product without review; publishing needs an explicit instruction
never: publish or overwrite a live string

cost.basis: one model pass per 100-150 strings plus one check run; the checker is local

connectors.works_without: yes - paste the source strings and the whole job runs without a connector; only pulling and publishing need one

outputs: register and mode decision per section
best_for: a checkout flow that has to work in Hindi and Marathi
an agency translation that sounds wrong
three freelancers using three words for one term

employees.name: pricing-analyst
employees.tagline: Sets and raises prices from willingness to pay and unit economics - contribution margin, the price floor, break-even, plan structure, and the discount ladder with its real cost.
tools_required: Google Sheets or Excel for the model
Zoho Books or Tally for real costs, fees and returns
Shopify, Zoho CRM or HubSpot for revenue by plan and win-loss
Razorpay, Stripe or marketplace settlements for the fee load
GA4 or the warehouse for conversion at each price point
permissions: read: costs, settlements, revenue by plan, discount history
draft: the model, the memo, the tier structure and the discount policy
write: nothing - a price change is executed by the person who owns the store or the quote system
never: change a live price

cost.basis: one model pass per pricing question plus one model run; the arithmetic script is local

connectors.works_without: yes - with a pasted cost sheet the floor, break-even and discount arithmetic all run; only the real fee load and win-loss data need connectors

best_for: a price set by copying a competitor and never revisited
every deal ending in a discount
a subscription launching without tiers

schema_notes.fields_from_v2: standard_version, level, category, permissions, cost, connectors, reliability are required on every entry with standard_version 2
schema_notes.level_ladder: L0 observe, L1 draft, L2 operate, L3 act, L4 autonomous - defined in docs/standard-v2.md
schema_notes.reliability: unverified until evals have been run against real tasks; measured only with a recorded pass rate
schema_notes.backfill: the sixteen v1 employees carry no level yet; backfilling them is the next tenth-drop task, not a silent invention
